title: Rational and real indexed monomials
statement: Let $\iota$ be any index type, let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and let $x:\iota\to\{\pm1\}$ be a sign assignment. The rational product of the signs $x(i)$ over $i\in S$, viewed as a real number, equals the real product of those signs.
